title: Parity run descriptor
description: The run descriptor spec-engine/run_engine.py (projection.load_inputs) reads: which desired graph S, which E(C) extract and which correspondence map one N(P(E(C),S)) run checks, how its frontier is selected, and the run's deterministic evaluation date. File paths are relative to the descriptor's own directory. Every field is a deterministic input -- there is NO wall-clock anywhere in a run (SEMANTICS sec 0).

doc.description: Free-text note for humans. Not an input to the run.

run_id.description: A stable human-chosen label for the run. Not hashed into the certificate.

spec_graph.description: Path (relative to this descriptor) of the desired-state graph S.

ec.description: Path (relative to this descriptor) of the realized E(C) extract.

correspondence.description: Path (relative to this descriptor) of the idmodel correspondence map.

frontier_selector.description: Explicit frontier node names (SEMANTICS sec 1.2). Empty/absent -> the node-level `frontier: true` flag, then the default capability closure.

as_of.description: The run's deterministic evaluation DATE (ISO-8601 calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD) -- never the wall clock. Waiver expiry is decided against it (SEMANTICS sec 8): a waiver whose `expiry` is before `as_of` is expired and suppresses nothing (an expiry ON the as_of date still suppresses: expiry is end-of-day UTC). REQUIRED whenever waivers are supplied -- the engine refuses to evaluate waivers without it (ENG-2).
